# Trump’s approval drops 2 points in 2 weeks: Reuters/Ipsos poll

One-third of Americans approve of President Trump’s job performance, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos survey.

The poll, conducted from Friday through Monday, found that 33 percent of 1,166 respondents approved of the job Trump is doing, while 64 percent disapproved. The poll had a margin of error of 3 percentage points. [...] The president’s approval rating, as measured by Reuters and Ipsos, is down 2 percentage points from a survey the polling partners released Aug. 3.
